localGuidance:
Flutter Android hardware bridge; iOS requires physical validation. Keep ECR/Viva procedures in adapters and use the durable executor. Do not retry unknown fiscal/payment outcomes. Preserve device TLS keys, identities and OTA compatibility. Commands: flutter analyze, flutter test <file>, dart run tool/quality.dart. Hardware operations require explicit authorization.

## Agent skills

### Issue tracker

Track this repository’s tickets and specs in GitHub Issues. See [Issue tracker](docs/agents/issue-tracker.md).

### Triage labels

Use the five project labels. See [Triage labels](docs/agents/triage-labels.md).

### Domain docs

Use one glossary and one ADR directory for this repository. See [Domain docs](docs/agents/domain.md).

test/fp21_bluetooth_test.dart.behavior: FP21 radio support, physical module and radio responses, a single user-requested enable, verified readback, changed register and uncertain USB reply
limitations: Uses a simulated USB peer. Android bonding and actual radio visibility require the physical acceptance check.

test/fiscal_byte_session_test.dart.behavior: Tremol and Datecs MX normal checkout validates framing, register identity, incomplete replies and original close recovery over USB and Bluetooth.
limitations: Native transport fixture; vendor firmware and cashier workflow require physical qualification.

test/fiscal_connection_setup_test.dart.behavior: Android register setup verifies and saves USB and paired Bluetooth, preserves the selected device across reopen and recovers from denied permission. FP21 radio setup reads before enabling and offers a read-only check after a lost response.
limitations: Flutter widgets and register protocol fixtures; physical Android permission dialogs and real peripherals are verified separately.

test/two_companion_checkout_test.dart.behavior: Exercises signed cash/card checkout, VAT admission, refusal before payment, and original-ID recovery across two Companions for each register profile. FP21 USB and Bluetooth tests include foreign-route sale and payment proofs after restart.
limitations: Loopback peers, synthetic register responses, payment and print counters.

test/signed_http_authorization_test.dart.behavior: Exercises receipt and terminal authorization on the signed local HTTP API, including external-card confirmation and original command recovery.
limitations: Synthetic grants and register or terminal responses.

test/fiscal_device_test.dart.behavior: Validates Datecs receipt drafts, effective VAT mapping, fiscal totals and original journal evidence when closure is uncertain.
limitations: Synthetic fiscal device, no physical journal or receipt.

test/datecs_device_client_test.dart.behavior: Reads Datecs MX VAT configuration and status, detects the profile, and checks that a lost response cannot dispatch a second report.
limitations: Local protocol fixtures.

test/datecs_native_test.dart.behavior: Checks the Romanian Datecs SDK bridge, configured VAT slots, accepted receipt constraints and lost responses.
limitations: Synthetic Android method channel.

test/adapters_test.dart.behavior: Checks Tremol receipt validation, tender and line representation, subtotal and close handling, and vendor protocol sequencing.
limitations: Loopback protocol fixtures.

test/update_release_test.dart.behavior: Public GitHub update discovery, bounded trusted redirects, upgrade-only version checks, APK size/hash verification and partial-file cleanup
limitations: Synthetic HTTP transport; native installer and public release are verified separately

tool/release.test.mjs.behavior: Release packaging rejects incompatible Android identity, certificate, debug mode and version metadata; manifests bind the exact source commit
limitations: Synthetic APK-tool output; actual apksigner and aapt are required in the release job

test/companion_scene_test.dart.behavior: All bundled artboards import and advance through assembly and continuous idle in the real Rive Flutter runtime
limitations: Host runtime; does not establish Android GPU, performance or physical-display acceptance

test/tls_setup_flow_test.dart.behavior: Connection preparation is single-flight, completes only on provisioning success, hides technical diagnostics under Advanced and redetects the network on explicit retry
limitations: Injected provisioning and network discovery; certificate verification is covered separately in tls_provisioning_test.dart

test/pairing_test.dart.behavior: Default PIN-first enrollment, Enterprise host selection and PIN clearing, rejected-PIN shortcut threshold, single-flight submission and persisted enrollment restoration
limitations: Injected enrollment service; no live ERP enrollment or credential issuance

test/setup_profile_test.dart.behavior: Audience-specific applications and equipment, legacy profile inference and stable supported step selection
limitations: Pure configuration; physical peripheral setup is not exercised

test/setup_visual_test.dart.behavior: Onboarding and printer setup render without overflow in portrait, short landscape and wide windows
limitations: Flutter widget capture with bundled motion stills; live Rive browser inspection recorded separately

test/console_test.dart.behavior: Ulanzi framing/ZIP/barriers, held-key suppression, fresh one-shot console views and scoped signed short-lived authorization
limitations: Synthetic USB and cryptographic identities; physical firmware qualification pending

test/console_diagnostics_test.dart.behavior: Diagnostic keys5/10 page navigation, randomized other keys, test/KDS mutual exclusion, in-flight/disconnect safety and opaque black rendered PNGs; console screen layout
limitations: Synthetic USB; actual display contrast and physical navigation require user trial

test/console_stream_test.dart.behavior: Real loopback TLS/WebSocket rejects copied grants without device proof and carries current-view presses and same-identity renewal
limitations: Synthetic USB/signing keys; not LAN or physical-device acceptance

test/production_print_test.dart.behavior: Bounded ESC/POS/ZPL templates, Romanian transliteration, signed production scope, durable duplicate/restart handling, queue admission and explicit reprints
limitations: Synthetic identities and mocked printer sends; no physical printer acceptance

test/printer_settings_test.dart.behavior: Optional printer settings loading, narrow layout, validation, persistence and enrollment/ECR identity preservation
limitations: Flutter widget harness; no manual browser or hardware inspection

test/niimbot_test.dart.behavior: NIIMBOT framing, bounded model identification, row encoding, print task rejection, fixed raster and shared authorized durable idempotency
limitations: Simulated Bluetooth transport; physical printer qualification pending

test/niimbot_wizard_test.dart.behavior: Bluetooth printer selection and persistence with real application theme in portrait, landscape and wide layouts
limitations: Mocked discovery and secure storage; rendered Flutter harness, not a physical iMin

test/provisional_label_test.dart.behavior: Real TLS and ES256 ERP lease plus KDS device proof authorize measured provisional output; scope, quantity, local-lot, expiry, duplicate report, exact reprint and durable command-limit enforcement
limitations: Loopback HTTPS and synthetic keys with mocked printer sends; no real LAN printer or statutory acceptance

test/customer_display_bundle_test.dart.behavior: Atomic offline bundle installation, cold restore, hash/size/scope rejection and previous-version preservation
limitations: Synthetic files; native Android and physical checks recorded separately

test/customer_display_stream_test.dart.behavior: Persistent TLS display stream verifies paired signatures, challenge freshness, payload integrity, expiry and revocation; rejects other operations and oversized frames
limitations: Real loopback TLS/WebSocket with synthetic identities; native display rendering verified separately on iMin

test/customer_display_test.dart.behavior: Bounded public basket payload and paired display dispatch without fiscal device access
limitations: Mocked Android method channel; physical iMin acceptance pending

test/customer_display_authorization_test.behavior: Signed paired POS can update display without operator; copied tokens, tampering, replay and ungranted operations fail
limitations: Synthetic signing identities; no physical LAN

test/setup_keyboard_test.dart.behavior: Wide setup retains the same editable state, keyboard focus and PIN/Enterprise input across keyboard insets and compact layout transitions
limitations: Flutter simulated Android keyboard insets; no physical iMin installation or keyboard trial.

test/fp21_usb_test.dart.behavior: Fragmented or corrupt replies, permission denial, non-fiscal test framing, durable replay after successful or partial print, and operator password exclusion from the journal
limitations: Simulated device and Android permission. Physical FP21 acceptance is tracked in the Companion checklist.

test/fp21_usb_dialog_test.dart.behavior: Device selection, status, explicit operator entry, single-flight print and recovery after an uncertain result
limitations: Simulated device and Android permission. Physical FP21 acceptance is tracked in the Companion checklist.

test/fp21_test_receipt_test.dart.behavior: Demonstration receipt totals, paper width, EAN check digit and exact native QR target
limitations: Layout assertions do not establish printed barcode readability.

test/fp21_usb_recovery_test.dart.behavior: An interrupted local sample requires exact journal evidence and a fresh, exclusively non-fiscal open state. Completion and uncertain recovery never replay printed merchandise.
limitations: Synthetic device reports; physical outcomes are documented in the implementation checklist.
